verdict.rationale: Formant documents real-time telemetry and status updates across the fleet, selectable data streams uploaded by the agent, a ROS-integrated agent, and remote commands such as ingesting a file or running a script on the device, so remote live state inspection is supported. Live ROS topic inspection is only implied by the ROS agent install, and log viewing is not documented; get_file can only approximate it. missing for 10: explicit documentation of live ROS topic browsing/inspection, a dedicated remote log viewer, independent or hands-on corroboration of debugging workflows.

support.subject: As a robotics engineer, I can inspect live topics, logs, and state on a deployed robot remotely to debug issues

citations.quote: Real-time telemetry and status updates across your entire fleet.
You can configure which data sources and data streams are uploaded to the cloud.
`formant.get_file` Ingest a file from your device.
The Agent SDK client contains a suite of methods which allow you to ingest telemetry data, receive and respond to commands, teleoperate your device, and more.
